priors = values('W1::Priors', 'G42:G44')
hypotheses = values('W1::Priors', 'H42:H44')
pos = values('W1::Likelihoods', 'H410:H412')
p_dict = {h: p for h, p in zip(hypotheses, priors)}
pos_dict = {h: po for h, po in zip(hypotheses, pos)}
# P(Clear source | two negative)
# Prior for Clear source = 0.2
# P(neg | Clear) = 1 - 0.1 = 0.9
# Two negative: 0.9 * 0.9 = 0.81
unnormalized_clear = p_dict['Clear source'] * ((1 - pos_dict['Clear source']) ** 2)
tot = sum(p * ((1 - pos_dict[h]) ** 2) for h, p in p_dict.items())
result = unnormalized_clear / tot

priors = dict(zip(values('W0::Priors', 'H42:H44'), values('W0::Priors', 'G42:G44')))
liks = dict(zip(values('W0::Likelihoods', 'G410:G412'), values('W0::Likelihoods', 'H410:H412')))
num = priors['Amber source'] * liks['Amber source']
den = sum(priors[h] * liks[h] for h in priors)
result = round(num / den, 6)

priors = dict(zip(values('W0::Priors', 'H42:H44'), values('W0::Priors', 'G42:G44')))
liks = dict(zip(values('W0::Likelihoods', 'G410:G412'), values('W0::Likelihoods', 'H410:H412')))
post = {}
for h in priors:
    pos = liks[h]
    neg = 1 - pos
    post[h] = priors[h] * pos * neg
den = sum(post.values())
result = round(post['Blue source'] / den, 6)
